title: Homotopy-pullback test for relative coslice boundary lifting
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, quasicategories, full subcategories, Kan complexes and weak homotopy equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], inner fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], sharp join coslices of [lem-coef-infinity-join-cocone-associativity], and trivial Kan fibrations of [def-weil-pbc-trivial-kan-fibration]. Let $q:C\to D$ be an inner fibration between quasicategories in one fixed sufficiently large universe. Let $j:A\hookrightarrow B$ be a degreewise injective map of small simplicial sets, let $d:B\to C$, put $e=dj$, and let $C_0\subseteq C$ be any full subcategory. For each vertex $W$ of $C_0$, suppose the square of strict apex fibers
$$\begin{array}{ccc}C_{d/}\times_C\{W\}&\longrightarrow&C_{e/}\times_C\{W\}\\
\downarrow&&\downarrow\\
D_{qd/}\times_D\{qW\}&\longrightarrow&D_{qe/}\times_D\{qW\}\end{array}$$
is a homotopy pullback of Kan complexes. All maps here are actual restrictions along $j$ or postcomposition by $q$. A homotopy pullback means that the map from the upper-left corner to the space of a point in the upper-right corner, a point in the lower-left corner, and a path between their images in the lower-right corner, with all higher simplices retained, is a weak homotopy equivalence; for this strictly commuting square use the constant path. Then the actual restriction map
$$C_0\times_C C_{d/}\longrightarrow C_0\times_C\bigl(C_{e/}\times_{D_{qe/}}D_{qd/}\bigr)$$
is a trivial Kan fibration: every prescribed simplex boundary and every prescribed target simplex lift with both restriction and projection equalities, including dimension zero. The apex projections in these pullbacks restrict to the last join block. There is no hypothesis on objects of $C$ outside $C_0$, no colimit-existence hypothesis, and $A$, $B$ or $C_0$ may be empty.
